local_findings.filename_search_scope: workspace CSV, parquet, jsonl names matching minute/intraday/auction/snapshot/tick or Chinese equivalents

provider_findings.one_minute_retention: official documentation states recent five trading days only
provider_findings.other_periods: recent data only; a start_date argument is not proof of historical availability
provider_findings.older_open_zero_warning: documentation warns non-latest dates may have open=0; do not treat as executable price

next_required_input: User-authorized historical minute/auction export or access to a source demonstrably covering the four dates; not existing holdings or brokerage credentials.
limitations: Minute bars alone do not prove queue fills or intraminute event ordering
These are selected historical case audits, not a statistically valid win-rate sample
Current-source limitation is not proof all market data providers lack this history
